landing.headline: Dinner, decided. For the whole week.
landing.sub: Wobblepot plans your family's meals around who's eating, what they avoid and what's already in the pantry. Then it writes the shopping list and stays with you at the stove.
landing.trust: Your data lives in the EU, and there are no ads.
landing.privateBeta: We're in private beta, so sign-up needs an invite code.

how.title: Three steps to a planned week

table.title: Tell it who's at the table
table.body: Adults, kids, allergies and what nobody will eat. Two minutes, once.

week.title: Get a week of meals
week.body: Breakfast, lunch and dinner for every day, with prep times. Swap any meal you don't like.

shop.title: Shop once, then cook
shop.body: One list of what you're missing, grouped by aisle. At the stove, the steps are on your phone, and you can ask about any of them.

note.title:
Made by a dad,

for a family of four

pantry.title: It knows your pantry
pantry.body: Tick what you have. The shopping list only shows what's missing, and the pantry updates when you mark a meal cooked.

vignette.caption: The cook view’s ingredients for baked salmon with asparagus. Salmon fillet, asparagus and olive oil are ticked as in the pantry. Lemon is not, so the list says 1 to buy.

imagine.title: Imagine a meal
imagine.body: Say what you're in the mood for, or snap a photo. You get three recipes to save, and they join the plan with the rest.

vignette.caption: A description typed into Imagine a meal, and below it the dish it produced on the planner: an acai bowl for breakfast, marked as your own recipe.
vignette.prompt: Something cold and fruity for breakfast, with granola
vignette.name: Acai bowl
vignette.description: Frozen acai with banana, granola and fresh fruit

kids.title: Portions follow the people
kids.body: Each member has a portion size, so a toddler isn't counted as an adult. Kid-friendly meals are marked.

vignette.caption: Three household members: two adults at a regular portion and a toddler at half a portion. The meal serves 2.5, so it calls for {quantity} of salmon.

cook.title: Cooking help on the counter
cook.body: Steps at a size you can read from across the kitchen, and a quick answer when you're stuck on one.

vignette.caption: A cooking step in large type with its Ask button, and the answer to the question "How do I know the salmon is done?" below it.
vignette.step: Lay the salmon and asparagus on the tray, drizzle with olive oil and bake for 12–15 minutes.
vignette.question: How do I know the salmon is done?
vignette.answer: Press the thickest part with a fork. It’s done when it flakes easily and is no longer glossy in the middle.

bot.heading: About Wobblepot-Bot
bot.lead: Wobblepot-Bot fetches recipe pages that users explicitly submit through the recipe import feature. It is not a crawler.

userAgent.heading: User-agent
userAgent.body: The bot identifies itself with the following User-Agent string:

does.heading: What it does
does.fetch: Fetches recipe pages that a signed-in user has pasted into the recipe import field.
does.extract: Extracts recipe data (ingredients, instructions, prep/cook time) for that user.

doesNot.heading: What it does not do
doesNot.crawl: No crawling. It never follows links off the submitted page.
doesNot.index: No indexing. It does not build a search index of your content.
doesNot.schedule: No scheduled fetches. It only fetches when a user initiates an import and never re-fetches the same URL on a schedule.

respect.heading: Respecting your site
respect.robots: Wobblepot-Bot honours robots.txt. If your rules disallow {token} (or *) for a URL, we will not fetch it.
respect.cache: We cache robots.txt decisions per origin for 24 hours to avoid repeated requests.
respect.disallow: Users who hit a disallow see a message explaining they can paste the recipe text directly instead.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: If you want us to stop (or start) fetching your site, or you have questions about how Wobblepot handles content, email {email}. The quickest way to deny us is to add a Disallow rule for {token} in your robots.txt.
